title: Uganda Culture, Community Life & Everyday Experiences — Set 02
approval: Approved by the platform owner for publication; live publication requires the question-set publishing workflow to be connected and verified.
instructions: Choose one option for each question. Opinion and experience questions have no right or wrong answer. For the mobile-money safety knowledge check, select the safest action. Do not enter names, phone numbers, exact addresses, account details or other identifying information.

questions.question: Which activity most often brings people in your community together?
Which cultural activity do you think younger generations should have more opportunities to learn?
Which issue do you think most needs attention in many local communities?
How do you usually prefer to receive information about local community events?
Which activity do you most enjoy during time with family?

options.D: Talking or relaxing together at home

questions.question: What matters most when choosing a place to meet friends?
How do you most often communicate with relatives who live far away?
Which form of transport do you use most often for everyday journeys?
What is the most important factor when choosing transport for a journey?
Which improvement would most help you feel safer when using mobile money?
Someone calls and asks you to tell them your mobile-money PIN. What is the safest response?

options.A: Share it if the caller knows your name
options.B: Share only part of the PIN

questions.explanation: A mobile-money PIN is confidential. Do not share it with callers or anyone claiming to be a service provider.

questions.question: What most influences your choice when buying everyday household products?
Which payment method do you most often prefer when shopping?
Which local service would you most like to see improved?
If you needed to report a local community problem, which channel would you be most likely to use first?
What is your main reason for using the internet on a typical day?

admin_review_checklist: Confirm wording is clear, neutral and appropriate for the intended audience.
Confirm every question has exactly four single-select options.
Do not assign correct answers to opinion or experience questions.
Verify the mobile-money safety answer and explanation.
Confirm no question requests names, phone numbers, exact addresses, PINs or other identifying information.
Confirm the set is relevant to a broad range of Ugandan respondents.
Document the client purpose, funding, respondent eligibility and reward amount before attaching any rewards.
Keep rewards subject to verified funding and published eligibility; do not promise guaranteed earnings.
